                       NOTICE OF PUBLIC MEETING
                            CITY OF PHOENIX
          ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY AND SUSTAINABILITY COMMISSION

Pursuant to A.R.S. Section 38-431.02, notice is hereby given to the members of the
ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY AND SUSTAINABILITY COMMISSION and to the
general public, that the ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY AND SUSTAINABILITY
COMMISSION will hold a meeting open to the public on July 9, 2026 at 2:00 p.m.
online using Webex.

2 ways to connect to Webex:

By phone
   1.   Dial 1-415-655-0001 United States Toll
   2.   When prompted enter Meeting number (access code) – 2341 896 4363
   3.   When prompted enter Meeting passcode – BkdQWY5p2s7
   4.   Please make sure your device is on mute unless you wish to speak.

By computer
   1.   Point browser to www.webex.com
   2.   Click on “Join” at top of screen.
   3.   Enter 2341 896 4363 in the prompt “Enter the meeting information”
   4.   Enter BkdQWY5p2s7 in the prompt “Enter the meeting password”
   5.   Once meeting begins, click on “Join Meeting”
   6.   Please make sure your device is on mute unless you wish to speak.

All items are for information, discussion and possible action.
